pieces.name: Pursuit
pieces.about: The Dark Knight side: a relentless low-string ostinato that never lets go, a four-note horn motif (D, A, B-flat, A), huge low brass hits, timpani and big drums.

pieces.name: Long Night
pieces.about: The Interstellar side: a repeating pipe-organ pattern that grows, low strings underneath, a slow long-note melody on violins and then horns, swelling to a full organ and orchestra.

pieces.name: Night Shift
pieces.about: Both, built on your Hook A: the hook becomes the low-string ostinato, with organ chords, the horn motif from Pursuit and the big hits on top.
